paragraphs: Rav Nechemya son of Rav [Huna] bar Chanilai.
Eruvin 43b relates that, absorbed in a halakhic discussion, he went beyond the Sabbath boundary on Shabbat. Rav Chisda told Rav Nachman: “Your student Nechemyah is in distress.”

Seder HaDorot writes that it found only Rav Nechemyah bar Chanilai, not Rav Nechemyah son of Rav Huna bar Chanilai. Hyman reports that the Rif, Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim read Rav Nechemyah son of Rav Huna bar Chanilai. He proposes this as the reading on 44b there.

notes.text: The bracketed Huna is in the supplied heading. The checked Eruvin passage has the shorter patronymic; Hyman reports the longer reading from the Rif, Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim.

The consulted Eruvin 43b reads Nechemyah son of Rav Chanilai. Hyman reports the longer patronymic from the Rif, Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim and proposes it at 44b; those exact readings were not independently inspected here.
